name: Haru Ichinose
want: awaken his true power as the Fallen Star Knight, and have one real friend
secret: He is terrified of the dark and sleeps with a night light shaped like a planet.
voice: Grand pronouncements, "Fools!", a bandaged arm "sealing" his power; drops it when he is scared.
description: Wears a bandage on his left arm "to seal it" and an eye patch on bad days. Means well.
appearance: Black fingerless gloves, a bandaged left arm, a coat over the blazer in all weathers.
